ios.desc:
Invader is a fast, minimal, modern podcast player. Search millions of shows, subscribe in a tap, and make every episode easier to listen to.

• Warp — skip silences, finish faster.
• Signal Boost — quiet voices, made clear.
• Transcripts — read, search, tap to jump.
• CarPlay — your queue, shows, and downloads on the dashboard.
• New-episode push alerts.
• Offline downloads.
• Speed, sleep timer, lock-screen controls.
• No account. No ads. No tracking.

Made by one person.

Invader Pro (auto-renewable) unlocks Warp, Signal Boost, and Transcripts. 7-day free trial, then $14.99/year. Renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel in Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://invader.gg/terms
Privacy Policy: https://invader.gg/privacy

quotes.text:
I got tired of podcast apps with bad UX, so I built and shipped the app I always wanted for myself. Designed entirely with myself as the user in mind, from someone who's spent ten years doing software engineering and product design. I'd love your feedback:

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/invader-podcast-app/id6781320719
